scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=admin-app && npm run build --workspace=user-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ADMIN,USER,API,TRACK -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=admin-app" "npm run dev --workspace=user-app" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=tracking/server"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n EMU,API,ADMIN,USER,TRACK -c red,green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run emulator" "npm run dev:local --workspace=backend" "VITE_USE_FIRESTORE_EMULATOR=true VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-margsutra npm run dev --workspace=admin-app" "VITE_USE_FIRESTORE_EMULATOR=true VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-margsutra npm run dev --workspace=user-app" "npm run dev --workspace=tracking/server"
